anchors.medium: Editorial illustration with hand-inked contours and flat printmaking shapes on warm paper
anchors.signature: Distinctive layered silhouettes, irregular human ink edges, one small accent area and generous breathing room

preferences.lighting: Quiet diffuse daylight conveyed through flat tonal layers
preferences.texture: Visible paper grain and light imperfect ink coverage; no glossy gradients
preferences.composition: Strong asymmetrical focal point with open paper space and a simple readable silhouette
preferences.typography: No lettering, captions or logos unless explicitly requested
